_readme: Bundled fallback for the IMD client, used only when api.imd.gov.in is
unreachable or returns an unusable response.
PROVENANCE AND STATUS: this is a hand-compiled snapshot assembled from widely
reported public records of named cyclone events and rainfall records. It is NOT
an authoritative IMD extract. Every record names the events it is derived from
in its `source` field. Values marked approximate below should be replaced with
an authoritative IMD data extract before this product is used for real permit
decisions. This limitation is restated in the README under 'Known limitations'.
Coverage is limited to coastal Tamil Nadu, which is where the damage
calibration model was fitted. A site outside every bounding box below yields no
historical context at all - the API reports its absence rather than
UNITS: wind in km/h (as IMD publishes it; converted to m/s in imd.py),
rainfall in mm, bounding boxes in WGS84 degrees.

districts.source: Strongest wind from Cyclone Vardah (Dec 2016), an IMD Very Severe Cyclonic Storm that made landfall near Chennai. Max daily rainfall from the 1 Dec 2015 Chennai floods (Tambaram). Cyclone Michaung (Dec 2023) is the most recent event in the count. Event count is APPROXIMATE, compiled from named storms affecting the district.
Strongest wind from Cyclone Thane (Dec 2011), an IMD Very Severe Cyclonic Storm that made landfall near Cuddalore. Rainfall figure from the same event. Event count is APPROXIMATE.
Strongest wind from Cyclone Gaja (Nov 2018), an IMD Very Severe Cyclonic Storm that made landfall in the Vedaranyam-Nagapattinam area. Event count is APPROXIMATE.
